limitations: Three authored held cels, not a complete articulated arm rig or continuously interpolated motion.
The two raised-arm cels require visual checking for hand volume, cloth folds and backing seams; bounded pixels do not establish aesthetic quality.
Every native 700 ms cycle repeats raise/lower and a 280 ms rest; the atlas cannot defer lowering until the third cycle.
Rest is the exact canonical cel; this is an intentional action exit, not proof of a foreground matte that reconstructs the neutral arm.
